speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The line's in Burby's book and in my coffer. Which of us has it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He has paper from the Hall. I have only the making.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Lilies that fester. I will not take the folder out to prove I wrote it twice. Proving it would be a claim, and I said there would not be one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The True Tragedy in May, this in December. I am being published by everybody but myself.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The folder stays shut. Navarre at two. Eat.
